svg.title: Architecture decisions
svg.desc: Architecture decisions. 1. CDN first, stateless API: Spikes land on Cloudflare, not the origin. Scaling the .NET API out is a config change. 2. Supabase here, Firebase there: Leaderboards need real SQL. Real-time sync across three apps is exactly Firestore’s job. 3. AI Gateway over direct calls: One place for rate limits, caching and per-request logs across every model provider. 4. Observability from day one: Login alerts, gateway logs, webhook and function traces ship with the product. 5. Security by design: Anomaly detection and owner alerts were part of the launch, not a patch after a breach.
